title: Synthetic Data Generator and Evaluator
summary: A command-line application that generates synthetic tabular data from a real CSV dataset using GaussianCopula and CTGAN methods, then evaluates the quality of the synthetic output with distribution, correlation, PCA, and privacy metrics. It imports and directly runs SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer, SingleTableMetadata, and evaluation/metrics modules as the core engine for both generation and quality assessment.
evidence: generator.py:41-48 imports GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer, SingleTableMetadata from sdv; evaluator.py:12-14 uses sdv.evaluation/sdv.metrics for quality scoring
